newsitem.title: USA: Alpha-Beta starts Phase II Betafectin study.
newsitem.headline: Alpha-Beta starts Phase II Betafectin study.

text.p: Alpha-Beta Technology Inc said Thursday that it has initiated a Phase II clinical trial for Betafectin PGG-Glucan for the prevention of infections in patients undergoing bowel resections for ulcerative colitis or Crohn's Disease.

According to Alpha-Beta, patients with ulcerative colitis or Crohn's Disease who are undergoing bowel resections are at high risk of developing post-operative infections, despite the use of prophylactic antibiotics.
The risk of infection is also increased because these patients are immunosuppressed from steroid and other drug therapies, it said.
The company said this study is a new indication for Betafectin in surgical prophylaxis and addresses a patient population not being evaluated in its ongoing Phase III study.
Betafectin PGG-Glucan, is a proprietary carbohydrate immunotherapeutic in clinical development for hematopoietic and infectious disease indications.
